description_en: Creates tags and adds the tags to resources at a time
description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的资源统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun edas tag-resources --resource-type application --resource-ids 000e5836-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-0d6ab2ac4877 --tags key_:_key1_,_value_:_v1_,_key_:_key2_,_value_:_v2 --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

application: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application

cluster: EDAS cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：
application：EDAS应用。 
cluster：EDAS集群
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 20 IDs in the format of a JSON array
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表， 列表的长度范围为1~20，JSON数组格式
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The key-value pairs. When you set this parameter, take note of the following limits:

You can add up to 20 tags to a resource.

The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

The tag key or tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), commas (,), asterisks (*), forward slashes (/), question marks (?), and colons (:).

Set this parameter to a JSON array
parameters.help_zh:
标签键值对。设置时，请注意以下限制：
单个资源最多贴20个标签。
key不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含**http://**或者**https://**。
key和value最大不超过128字符，仅支持英文字母、数字和短划线（-）、半角逗号（,）、星号（*）、正斜线（/）、半角问号（?）和半角冒号（:）的组合。
JSON格式字符串
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The region in which the resource resides
parameters.name: resource_region_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
